What Cleveland-Cliffs says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAThe Company expects fourth-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA 2 to be approximately $715 million, an increase from the third quarter as a result of increased pricing, partially offset by seasonality, increased maintenance outages, input costs and incentive compensation accruals.
  • Full year 2027: adjusted EBITDABased on 2027 contract changes and prevailing price forecasts, the Company would expect 2027 adjusted EBITDA to exceed $4 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 19, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
